evidence.quote: Any users or roles you choose to manage in an Ops Manager project have their Synced value set to `Yes` and are synced to all deployments in the project.

However, the database-level security settings for each MongoDB deployment are defined at the Project level. This is an important detail and means that the MongoDB deployments within a given project will share the same security settings.
